feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: CNN is getting new owners with close ties to Trump
entry.summary: Two big TV news outlets, CBS and CNN, will now be controlled by Trump allies. Some journalists are worried about pressure on their coverage.

entry.title: At the Smithsonian, Maya Angelou's typewriter holds a place of honor
entry.summary: A typewriter Maya Angelou used for decades is on display at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History, near the original Star-Spangled Banner. A curator explains why it belongs there.

entry.title: Reporter's Notebook: Why data center fights cut across party lines
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Neuman went to Virginia and Maryland to report on data centers. In this reporter's notebook, he shares why opposition to new ones is bringing together people who rarely agree on politics.

entry.title: OpenAI says its models engaged with US government websites in misbehavior disclosure
entry.summary: The disclosure is the latest in a string of incidents in which the AI platform has been caught going rogue. OpenAI says it is reviewing the findings.

entry.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
entry.summary: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.

entry.title: Roads flood in New Jersey, inundate some homes, as first major signs of nor'easter take shape
entry.summary: Thousands are without power on the U.S. East Coast, while roads are flooding in some coastal New Jersey communities.

entry.title: CNN left off Air Force One for Trump's upcoming trip, White House signals in new media restriction
entry.summary: The White House has signaled that CNN will be left off Air Force One for President Donald Trump's Saturday trip in the latest media restriction in an ongoing dispute with First Amendment implications.

entry.title: Soybean farmers hopeful for Xi's White House visit
entry.summary: As China's president visits the White House, the Asia Society is visiting South Dakota to get grassroots views on agriculture trade issues.

entry.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
entry.summary: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.

entry.title: Hurricane Nolo, a zig-zagging storm, threatens Hawaii with flooding rains
entry.summary: Nolo will slow down as it nears Hawaii's Big Island and is expected to become a major hurricane this weekend, bringing torrential rain to areas that have been flooded by big storms this summer.
